# Provider fixtures

Response bodies in the shapes the providers' public API references document
(Anthropic Messages API `2023-06-01`, OpenAI Chat Completions). They are
written from those references, not captured: the build sessions have no
provider keys and no route to the provider APIs. IDs and text are synthetic.
When a live capture becomes possible (a real key in the vault on the box),
replace each file with a captured body after redaction and keep the names.
